settings.language.title: Settings: label of the Language picker.
settings.language.system: Settings > Language: the first option, follow the device's language.
codeblock.copy: Chat code block header row, and the full screen code view's top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the code).
codeblock.copied: Chat and full screen views: label a copy icon button takes for 1.5 s after copying, shown as a checkmark (status, past participle: the text was copied).
codeblock.expand: Chat code block header row: accessibility label and tooltip of the expand icon button that opens the code full screen (verb, command).
codeblock.wrap: Full screen code view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of a toggle icon; on, long lines wrap; off, they scroll sideways (verb phrase, command).
codeblock.untitled: Chat code block header row, shown in place of the language name when the code names none; also the full screen code view's name for screen readers (noun: program code).
table.copy: Full screen table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the table as Markdown text).
table.expand: Chat, above a table wider than the message: accessibility label and tooltip of the expand icon button that opens the table full screen (verb, command).
table.fullscreen_title: Full screen table view: its name for screen readers (noun: a data table).
fullscreen.close: Full screen code or table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the close icon button (verb, command).
host_down.device_offline.title: Offline panel (this device has no network, so no Host can answer), title (heading) when this phone or computer has no network at all.
host_down.device_offline.body: Offline panel (this device has no network, so no Host can answer), one plain sentence under the title, when this phone or computer has no network at all. Clarp is the product name, never translated.
host_down.auth_expired.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the Host refused this device: it must be paired (signed in) again. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.auth_expired.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the Host refused this device: it must be paired (signed in) again. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.wrong_address.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when something else answers at the Host's saved address. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.wrong_address.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when something else answers at the Host's saved address.
host_down.server_stopped.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the computer answers but the Clarp program on it is not running. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.server_stopped.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the computer answers but the Clarp program on it is not running. Clarp is the product name, never translated.
host_down.tailscale_off.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when Tailscale (the private network) seems off on this device. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.tailscale_off.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when Tailscale (the private network) seems off on this device. Tailscale is a product name, never translated.
host_down.host_asleep.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the computer seems switched off or asleep. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.host_asleep.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the computer seems switched off or asleep.
host_down.unknown.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the reason is unknown. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.unknown.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the reason is unknown. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.last_seen: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), small meta text: when the Host last answered. {when} is a relative time from the formatter, like "2 hours ago".
host_down.status.reconnecting: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), quiet status line while the app is asking the Host again right now.
host_down.status.retry_in: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), quiet status line: when the app asks the Host again. {in} is a relative time from the formatter, like "in 30 seconds".
host_down.status.back_online: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), status line shown for two seconds when the Host answers again (adjective phrase, not a command).
host_down.read_only: Message field placeholder (hint text in the empty field) while the Host does not answer; saved messages stay readable. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.list_row: Chat list (and the Hosts list in Chat settings): one row above a Host's dimmed chats when it does not answer; tapping or clicking opens the Host-down panel. {when} as in host_down.last_seen. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.banner: App-wide banner at the top when this phone or computer has no network at all (statement, not a title).
host_down.action.retry: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): ask the Host again now.
host_down.action.check_tailscale: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): opens the Tailscale admin page to check this device is connected. Tailscale is a product name, never translated.
host_down.action.pair_again: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): sign this device in to the Host again with a new token.
host_down.action.edit_address: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): change the saved web address of the Host.
host_down.action.switch_host: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): open another of the user's Hosts instead. Host stays untranslated.
host_down.copy_diagnostics: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative; "Copy" is the verb): copies a short technical text for support to the clipboard.
host_down.copied: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), toast (short confirmation) after the diagnostics text was copied (past participle).
host_down.details: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), label of a closed disclosure (noun, plural) that shows the raw technical detail of the last attempt.
host_down.close: Host-down dialog: accessibility label and tooltip of the close (×) button (verb, imperative).
host_down.token_or_link: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), placeholder of the token field under Pair again. "?token=" is literal, never translated.
host_down.token: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), placeholder of the token field under Pair again, for another saved Host (noun: an access token).
host_down.token_needed: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), error text under the token field when what was pasted is not a token. "clarp-admin url" is a command, never translated.
error.usage_limit: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do. {backend} is a backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.usage_limit_until: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do. {backend} is a backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated; {time} is a time already written in the language (e.g. 18:27, Sat 18:27, 5 Dec 18:27).

error.account_plan: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do. {backend} is a backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated; {model} is a model name, never translated.
error.free_model_restricted: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.
error.connection: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do. {backend} is a backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.

error.prompt_too_long: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.

error.ended_from_outside: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.
error.interrupted: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.
error.not_started: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.
error.folder_missing: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do. {folder} is a folder path.
error.folder_missing_no_path: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.
error.provider_mismatch: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.
error.session_locked: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do. {backend} is a backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.moved: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do.
error.unknown: Chat, failed-turn card: one plain sentence saying why the agent's turn failed and what to do. {backend} is a backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.action.retry_at: Chat, failed-turn card: button label. {time} is a time already written in the language (e.g. 18:27, Sat 18:27, 5 Dec 18:27).
error.action.copy_details: Chat, failed-turn card: button label. Copies a diagnostic text for an agent to read; owner's words in Norwegian: "Kopier diagnose".
error.details: Chat, failed-turn card: disclosure that shows the provider's raw error text.
error.copied: Chat, failed-turn card: brief confirmation after "Copy diagnostics". Must match the Host-down screen's "copied" wording.
error.retry_scheduled: Chat, failed-turn card: note after a scheduled retry was accepted. {time} is a time already written in the language (e.g. 18:27, Sat 18:27, 5 Dec 18:27).
error.retry_sent: Chat, failed-turn card: note after the message was sent again.
error.action_failed: Chat, failed-turn card: note when a button's request was refused.
error.repeat_count: Chat, failed-turn card: badge for how many times the same failure repeated ("3×"). Keep it short.
